fire: At the Istanbul office, Murat handed the visitor a folder.

Our guide in Izmir introduced Bulent to the group.
The Turkish research team thanked Memis for checking the tables.

At the reception in Konya, Turgut welcomed the guests.
The producer in Istanbul invited Mahir to read the script.

notes: Card peaks occur early in names such as Memis, Murat, Adnan and Bulent, with opposite-pole peaks often in name endings. Controls retain a Turkish setting but change the personal name. Codex-authored; cards only.
